input: Research LASIK surgery consultation options nearby

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's city or region is essential to finding geographically relevant clinics and surgeons — without it, no meaningful local search is possible.
The user may want only an initial free consultation, or a full clinical evaluation including eye exams and candidacy assessment — this changes which providers to target.
Whether this is for the user themselves or someone else (e.g., a spouse or parent) affects what criteria matter most, such as age-related eligibility or prescription range.
LASIK procedure costs vary widely ($1,000–$4,000+ per eye); knowing the budget determines whether to include premium providers or focus on affordable/financing options.

Some people prioritize surgeon reputation and reviews, others prioritize technology used (e.g., bladeless, wavefront-guided), and others want the fastest appointment — this shapes how to rank options.
The output of this research could be a shortlist of clinics, a comparison table, booked appointments, or just a vetted single recommendation — defining 'done' prevents over- or under-researching.
Knowing whether the user wants to do this research online themselves, have a list of calls to make, or get help booking directly determines the immediate next action and format of the plan.

gold.taskTitle: Research nearby LASIK surgery consultation options
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate LASIK surgery consultation options available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What city or zip code should the search be centered on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to scope the search to genuinely nearby clinics and avoid irrelevant results.

questions.title: Are you researching for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Determine whose eyes and eligibility criteria are being evaluated, which affects the type of consultation and candidacy factors to investigate.

questions.title: Do you want free consultations, full clinical evaluations, or both?
questions.description: Clarify the scope of the consultation being sought — free screenings vs. comprehensive pre-op evaluations differ significantly in what they include.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for the full LASIK procedure?
questions.description: Budget determines whether to include premium laser centers, mid-range providers, or clinics offering financing plans in the research.

questions.title: What matters most to you when comparing clinics?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user prioritizes surgeon experience, specific technology, patient reviews, or speed of appointment shapes how options are ranked.

questions.title: What does a useful end result of this research look like to you?
questions.description: Define done — is it a shortlist of 3 clinics, a single booked appointment, a comparison spreadsheet, or something else?

questions.title: Do you want to research online, make calls, or book directly?
questions.description: Determines the format and immediate next action — whether to produce a web research checklist, a call script, or steps to schedule an appointment online.
